# EmailCampaign

> EmailCampaign is a modern, AI-powered multi-tenant email marketing and campaign outreach platform built for high deliverability, automated DNS verification, custom sending domains, and real-time analytics.

EmailCampaign equips marketing teams, sales development representatives, recruiters, agencies, and fast-growing startups with a reliable infrastructure to create, personalize, dispatch, and monitor outbound email campaigns without landing in spam folders.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI-Powered Outreach & Copywriting**: Built-in AI assistants for generating high-converting email drafts, subject line open-rate prediction, dynamic tone adjustment, and personalized outreach sequences.
- **Custom Sending Domains & Dedicated DNS**: Automated setup and verification for SPF, DKIM (CNAME), DMARC, and custom MAIL FROM return-path subdomains with platform-managed or organization-owned AWS SES identities.
- **Multi-Provider Delivery Backbone**: Seamless integration with Amazon SES, Google Workspace / Gmail SMTP, Microsoft 365 / Outlook SMTP, SendGrid, and Brevo with encrypted credential storage and automatic health checks.
- **Real-Time Deliverability & Analytics**: Live tracking of email dispatch, inbox delivery rate, opens (tracking pixel), click attribution, bounce classifications (soft/hard), spam complaints, and real-time WebSocket progress updates.
- **Contact & List Management**: High-throughput contact imports via CSV/Excel, smart segmentation, deduplication, custom tags, and dynamic template variables (`{{first_name}}`, `{{company}}`, `{{unsubscribe_url}}`).
- **Two-Way Inbox & Reply Handling**: Integrated webmail inbox for receiving recipient responses, managing conversations, and handling sender replies directly within the platform.
- **Compliance & Unsubscribe Management**: RFC-compliant one-click unsubscribe headers, hosted branded unsubscribe landing pages, automated suppression lists, CAN-SPAM, and GDPR compliance guaranteed.
- **Multi-Tenant Organizations & Role-Based Access**: Complete workspace isolation per organization, team member invites, role permissions (Owner, Admin, Member), and granular tenant quota limits.
